'''Sylen Kempar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] who held the title of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]], he was stationed at the [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he shared his knowledge with fellow [[Sith Warrior]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Sylen Kempar appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a class trainer for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Warrior class on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" />
